profile.headline: Frontend Developer at Domino's
profile.summary: Web developer, mobile developer, and JavaScript enthusiast.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Design and develop the Movatic user app and admin site for bikeshare, bike parking, and scooter rentals
- Develop the APIs for both the app and admin site 
- Design, plan, and implement specifications for new features, ranging from adding new maintenance features for admins to drafting a plan to convert from a REST API to GraphQL
- Have the flexibility to efficiently balance front end work, back end work, and project management

positions.title: Front-end TA
positions.description:
- Support instructors by providing student grading and feedback
- Support students during labs and activities, and help troubleshoot the technical issues they face
- Coordinate bi-weekly retros with students
- Provide office hour support to students
- Assist with teaching multiple different front end frameworks to students

positions.title: HR Administrator
positions.description:
Provide personalized customer service for each of our unique clients via phone and email
Primary manager of the main email queue for client questions
Assist with creation and management of web accounts
Process new hire paperwork
Assist with processing of worker's compensation claims
Assist with benefit administration
Optimize ineffecient processes
Other various HR functions as needed

positions.title: Service Desk Consultant, ITS Service Center
positions.description:
Answer questions, troubleshoot problems, and provide technical support to callers to the 4HELP hotline while providing excellent customer service
Assist with training new staff
